cooking.show_shared: Show Shared Recipes in My Main List
cooking.url_engine_desc_standard_html: Standard reads the page's schema.org/Recipe data. Free and fast; works on most major recipe sites.
cooking.url_engine_desc_enhanced_html: Enhanced runs recipe-scrapers, which has site-specific extractors for ~300 popular sites and falls back to schema.org on everything else.
cooking.url_engine_desc_smart_html: Smart hands the page to your Trace AI. Slower and uses your AI quota, but recovers recipes from sites that block scrapers or hide their content in non-standard markup.
cooking.smart_note: Smart sends every URL import to your AI, which uses your provider's quota on every paste. Standard or Enhanced are free and handle most sites; consider setting Smart only as a fallback.
cooking.enhanced_fallback_desc: When the server is unreachable or recipe-scrapers isn't installed, fall back to this.
